Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ الْمُنْزَلِ
Translation: O Allah, You have said in Your revealed Book

Arabic text: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْ أُنزِلَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ
Translation: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed
And this is the month of Ramadan
And it has passed away
So I ask You by Your noble countenance
And by Your perfect words

Arabic text: اِنْ كَانَ بَقِيَ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ لَمْ تَغْفِرْهُ لِي
Translation: If there remains any sin for which You have not forgiven me
Or You intend to punish me for it
Or to hold me accountable for it

Arabic text: اَنْ لَا يَطْلُعَ فَجْرُ هٰذِهِ اللَيْلَةِ
Translation: That the dawn of this night should not break
Nor should this month come to an end
Except that You have forgiven it for me
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
O Allah, praise be to You with all Your praises
The first of them and the last of them
Those You have attributed to Yourself
And those that praising creatures have said
The diligent ones, the counted ones
Those who abundantly remember You
And express gratitude to You
Those whom You have helped to fulfill Your rights
From among the varieties of Your creation
From the closest angels
And the prophets and messengers
And all types of those who speak
And those who glorify You from all the worlds
For You have caused us to reach the month of Ramadan
While we have from Your blessings
And we have from Your portions and Your kindness
And the manifestation of Your favors
For that, to You belongs the utmost praise
The eternal, the everlasting
The constant, the immortal, the perpetual
That which will never end throughout eternity
Great is Your praise

Arabic text: أَعَنْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حَتّىٰ قَضَيْتَ عَنَّا صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ
Translation: You have helped us in it until You fulfilled for us its fasting and its standing

Arabic text: مِنْ صَلاَةٍ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَّا فِيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ
Translation: From prayer and whatever righteous acts we performed in it
Or gratitude or remembrance
O Allah, accept it from us with Your best acceptance
And Your overlooking and Your pardon
And Your forgiveness and Your amnesty
And the reality of Your pleasure

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ تُظَفِّرَنَا فِيْهِ بِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ مَطْلُوْبٍ
Translation: Until You grant us success in it with every sought-after good
And abundant, gifted bounty
And protect us in it from everything fearful
Or affliction brought forth
Or sin committed

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّ أَسْئَلُكَ بِعَظيْمِ مَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the greatness with which any of Your creation has asked You
By Your noble names
And Your beautiful praise
And Your special supplications

Arabic text: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: That You bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ شَهْرَنَا هٰذَا أَعْظَمَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And that You make this month of ours the greatest month of Ramadan that has passed over us
Since You brought us into this world, in blessings
In the protection of my religion
And the salvation of my soul
And the fulfillment of my needs
And accept my intercession in my requests
And complete Your favor upon me
And turn away evil from me
And clothe me with well-being in it

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِمَّنْ اَدْخَرْتَ لَهُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ
Translation: And make me, by Your mercy, among those for whom You have reserved the Night of Power

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَهَا لَهُ خَيْرًا مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
Translation: And made it for them better than a thousand months
In the greatest reward
And precious treasures
And beautiful gratitude
And long life
And lasting ease
O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy and Your favor
And Your pardon and Your blessings
And Your majesty and Your ancient kindness and favors

Arabic text: اَنْ لَا تَجْعَلَهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنَّا لِشَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
Translation: That You do not make this our last experience of the month of Ramadan

Arabic text: حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنَاهُ مِنْ قَابِلٍ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ حَالٍ
Translation: Until You cause us to reach it next year in the best condition

Arabic text: وَتُعَرِّفَنِيْ هِلاَلَهُ مَعَ النَّاظِرِيْنَ إِلَيْهِ وَالْمُعْتَرِفِيْنَ لَهُ
Translation: And show me its crescent moon with those who look at it and recognize it
In the most complete of Your well-being
And the most pleasant of Your blessings
And the most extensive of Your mercy
And the most abundant of Your portions

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّيَ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ لِيْ رَبٌّ غَيْرُهُ
Translation: O my Lord, besides whom there is no Lord for me

Arabic text: لَا يَكُوْنُ هٰذَا الْوِدَاعُ مِنِّيْ لَهُ وِدَاعَ فَنَاءٍ
Translation: Let not this farewell of mine to it be a farewell of extinction
Nor the last of my encounters with it

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ تُرِيَنِيْهِ مِنْ قَابِلٍ فِيْ اَوْسَعِ النِّعَمِ وَأَفْضَلِ الرَّجَاءِ
Translation: Until You show it to me next year with the most expansive blessings and the best hope
While I am for You in the best fulfillment
Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication
O Allah, hear my supplication
And have mercy on my humility and submission to You
And my neediness and my reliance upon You
And I am submitting to You
I do not hope for success or well-being

Arabic text: وَلَا تَشْرِيْفًا وَلَا تَبْلِيْغًا إِلَّا بِكَ وَمِنْكَ
Translation: Or honor or attainment except through You and from You
And bestow Your favor upon me
Great is Your praise
And holy are Your names

Arabic text: بِتَبْلِيْغِ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَأَنَا مُعَافًا مِنْ كُلِّ مَكْرُوْهٍ وَمَحْذُوْرٍ
Translation: By enabling me to reach the month of Ramadan while I am protected from all that is disliked and feared
And from all calamities

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَعَانَنَا عَلَى صِيَامِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ وَقِيَامِهِ
Translation: Praise be to Allah who has helped us to fast and stand in prayer during this month
Until He has enabled me to reach its last night
